title: Mercy Seat
summary: The mercy seat was the cover of the ark and was associated with atonement, God’s presence, and priestly sprinkling of blood.
background: On the Day of Atonement, blood was sprinkled before and on the mercy seat. This background helps explain atonement and Hebrews’ temple imagery.
teachingHelp: Use mercy-seat background to point to atonement, holiness, and God’s gracious provision for sinners.
